fields.label: Rename to
fields.help: Optional replacement identifier for ALTER DOMAIN <old> TO <new>.

fields.label: Base data type
fields.help: Firebird 5 SQL type such as VARCHAR(120), NUMERIC(12,2), INT128, DECFLOAT(34), BOOLEAN, TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, or BLOB.

fields.label: BLOB subtype
fields.help: Optional SUB_TYPE for BLOB domains: TEXT, BINARY, or a signed 16-bit custom subtype integer.

fields.label: BLOB segment size
fields.help: Optional SEGMENT SIZE (1..65535) for BLOB domains.

fields.label: Array bounds
fields.help: Optional shorthand for 1..16 Firebird array dimensions (upper > lower), such as [1:4] or [1:3, 1:2].

fields.label: Array dimensions
fields.help: Structured multi-dimensional array bounds (up to 16 dimensions; every upper bound must strictly exceed its lower bound).

fields.label: Character set
fields.help: Optional CHARACTER SET clause for CHAR, VARCHAR, and BLOB SUB_TYPE TEXT domains (for example UTF8, ISO8859_1, ASCII, OCTETS).

fields.label: Collation
fields.help: Optional COLLATE clause emitted after constraints on CREATE DOMAIN (for example UNICODE_CI_AI, UNICODE_CI, UTF8).

fields.label: Default expression
fields.help: SQL literal, NULL, or context variable without the DEFAULT keyword (for example 0.00, 'ACTIVE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_USER).

fields.label: Comment
fields.help: Stored in RDB$DESCRIPTION via COMMENT ON DOMAIN.

fields.label: Clear comment
fields.help: Clears RDB$DESCRIPTION via COMMENT ON DOMAIN <name> IS NULL.

fields.label: Constraint name
fields.help: Optional constraint identifier for ALTER DOMAIN <name> ADD CONSTRAINT <constraint_name> CHECK (...).

fields.label: Check expression
fields.help: Predicate using Firebird's VALUE keyword (for example VALUE BETWEEN 0 AND 100, VALUE IN ('LOW', 'HIGH'), or VALUE IS NULL OR VALUE SIMILAR TO '[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{5}').

fields.label: Drop check constraint
fields.help: Drops the existing domain CHECK constraint (automatically combined before ADD CHECK when replacing a constraint).

notes: Enterprise Firebird 5.0 domain form verified against the Firebird 5.0 Language Reference and FlameRobin parity contract: scalar/extended precision types, BLOB subtype & segment size, 1..16 array dimensions (upper > lower), character sets, collations, defaults, NOT NULL, named/unnamed VALUE check constraints, rename, and COMMENT ON DOMAIN.
